about.title: About AfroPonte
about.intro: AfroPonte is a bridge between Africa and Brazil: a directory that helps you find African restaurants, shops, hair salons and tailoring workshops near you.

sections.p: To make African and Afro-descendant businesses in Brazil easier to find, and to connect the people who run them with the people looking for them: tourists, students, migrants, business travelers and families.
Search for a business by city, category or country of origin, see it on the map, save favorites, leave a review, and write directly to a merchant from the app, without going through WhatsApp.
Listing your business is free. Every listing is checked before it is published, and reviews and photos are moderated to keep the directory reliable.
AfroPonte grows with its users: suggest a business that is missing, report wrong information, share your experience.
The site is available in French, English and Portuguese.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: A question, a suggestion, a business to add or a problem to report? Write to us.

sections.p: To contact a merchant, use the in-app messaging from their listing.
To list or claim your business, create a merchant account. Need help? Write to us.
An incorrect listing or inappropriate content? Use the report button, or write to us and tell us which page it is on.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what data AfroPonte collects, why, and what your rights are, in line with Brazil’s General Data Protection Law (LGPD, Law No. 13,709/2018).

sections.p: Account: name, email address, password (encrypted), phone number (optional), language and account type. Activity: favorites, reviews, photos and messages exchanged in the app. Location: only if you use “Near me”, to calculate nearby businesses.
To create and secure your account, display the directory, enable messaging, moderate content and improve the service. We do not sell your data.
Conversations are private. Only reported conversations may be reviewed by the moderation team, to handle the report.
Your data is only shared with the technical providers needed to run the site (hosting, sending emails), or when the law requires it. Reviews and photos you publish are visible to other visitors.
The site saves your language and your login session in your browser. At this time, it does not use advertising cookies.
Your data is kept as long as your account is active. You can ask for your account and data to be deleted at any time.
You can request access, correction, export or deletion of your data, and withdraw your consent. Write to {{email}}.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By using AfroPonte, you agree to the rules below.

sections.p: AfroPonte is a free directory of African businesses in Brazil, with built-in messaging. We do not sell any product or service ourselves.
You are responsible for your account and for keeping your password confidential. Give accurate information. An account may be suspended in case of abuse.

Merchants are responsible for the accuracy of their information (address, opening hours, prices). Each listing is approved by the team before publication, and may be refused or removed if it is false or misleading.
Only post honest content that belongs to you and respects others. Insults, harassment, discrimination, illegal content, fake reviews and spam are forbidden. Content may be moderated or removed.
You can report a listing, a review, a photo or a message. The team reviews them and may suspend the accounts involved.
Listing information comes from merchants and users: we cannot guarantee that it is always accurate. Exchanges and purchases between users and merchants are made at their own responsibility.
We may change these terms. The update date is shown at the bottom of the page.

legal.title: Legal notice
legal.intro: Information about the publisher of the AfroPonte site.

sections.p: The site is published by {{owner}}. Contact: {{email}}.
The site is hosted by a web hosting provider; its details are available on request at {{email}}.

The AfroPonte name, logo, site design and texts are protected. Photos and texts published by users and merchants remain their property; by publishing them, they allow AfroPonte to display them on the site.
The processing of your data is described in the privacy policy.
To report unlawful content, use the report button or write to {{email}}.
